name: Perseus Cluster field 4 (Hubble)
blurb: A field in the core of the Perseus Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: perseuscluster4-hubble
story: Among the big galaxies of this rich cluster drift faint, smooth dwarf galaxies. Hubble surveyed the cluster's core to learn how such small galaxies hold together against the cluster's pull.

claims.text: PERSEUSCLUSTER4 is a Hubble program 10201 target in the Perseus Cluster, a rich cluster of galaxies
The Perseus Cluster is also known as Abell 426 and is one of the richest nearby galaxy clusters
Hubble ACS imaging (F555W, F814W) of fields in the Perseus Cluster core was used to study its dwarf galaxies
The Perseus core dwarfs look smooth, and some need a large dark matter halo to avoid being disrupted by the cluster
